literal: Clarity lacking that [action] they will not begin, disgrace which is called ruin fearing-those.
translation: Those who fear the ruin called disgrace will not embark on any action that lacks clarity.
modern: அவமானம் என்னும் துன்பத்திற்கு அஞ்சுகின்றவர்கள், தெளிவில்லாத செயலைத் தொடங்க மாட்டார்கள்.
explanation: This couplet emphasizes the importance of clarity and foresight before initiating any task. Those who are deeply concerned about their reputation and dread the ruin brought by disgrace (இளிவு) will never start an action without complete certainty (தெளிவு). The word 'ஏதப்பாடு' refers to the state of affliction or ruin that results from failure. By ensuring thorough clarity beforehand, one guards against the shame of an unsuccessful venture.
